subject: First sighting fish
topic: No one had ever seen a fish like this alive before.
script:
No one had ever seen a fish like this alive before.
NOAA filmed it in twenty sixteen, about two and a half kilometers deep in the Marianas.
It's only about ten centimeters long.
Its skin is transparent and jelly-like, with no scales at all.
Its eyes are tiny, and have no color in them.
It belongs to a family of fish related to cusk eels.
Experts say this was the first time anyone had seen a member of its family alive.
Viewers called it the fish version of Casper the octopus.
What would you call it?
